== [[Feedback:Game updates/20120913|September 13, 2012]] ==
* Reduced casting time to 1 second.
* Reduced recharge to 15 seconds. 
* Changed functionality to: "For 1...6 seconds, target foe's legs are encased in ice, causing the foe to move 66% slower. If that foe has Cracked Armor, the chill seeps through causing 5...9 Health degeneration."
